task.description: Validate src/design/iss0620-gbl134-per-tenant-forward-fix.md and the migration it specifies, migrations/GBL-137_iss0620_recreate_per_tenant_shadows.sql, for GH-573/ISS-0620 (BLOCKER -- a 4-table misclassification in GBL-134 that already executed a destructive DROP against tenant_default in 2 databases with no guard). This migration lineage (GBL-134/135/136) has a documented history of 2 prior classification errors -- apply extra scrutiny. GBL-137 is purely additive (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS only, no DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE) recreating tenant_default copies of 4 tables (artifact_activation_groups, entity_definitions, entity_record_latest, entity_type_instances) that GBL-134 wrongly dropped. Verify independently: (1) the recreated schema in GBL-137 matches migrations/094_entity_subsystem.sql and migrations/046_repository_activations.sql EXACTLY (column names, types, constraints, defaults, indexes) -- read all three files yourself, do not trust the design doc's transcription; (2) confirm zero FK dependents on any of the 4 tables anywhere in src/ or migrations/ (the design claims this, independently grep and confirm); (3) confirm the migration is genuinely idempotent and safe to run against a tenant schema that already has these tables (bpm_test, due to an unrelated reprovisioning event) AND one that's still missing them (bpm_dev) -- read the DO block's guard logic; (4) confirm GBL-134's header correction is a comment-only change, migration body byte-for-byte unchanged (run git diff or compare); (5) confirm this migration does NOT attempt to drop the now-stray public copies of these 4 tables (that's explicitly out of scope, deferred to a future migration) -- verify no DROP statement anywhere in GBL-137; (6) confirm the tools/lint_dual_schema_table_names.py ALLOW_LIST addition is scoped to exactly these 4 names with a clear temporary/pending-followup explanation, not a silent permanent suppression; (7) independently re-verify ISSUE-FIXER's claim that no non-local/production database is affected (grep docker-compose*.yml, .github/workflows/*.yml yourself); (8) confirm the incidental ISS-0623/GH-580 finding is correctly filed/queued and NOT bundled into this fix's scope.
acceptance_criteria: Recreated schema in GBL-137 confirmed byte-for-byte equivalent to original creating migrations
Idempotency and existence-guard logic confirmed correct for both known database states
GBL-134 header correction confirmed comment-only, body byte-for-byte unchanged
No destructive statement (DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE) anywhere in GBL-137
lint_dual_schema_table_names.py ALLOW_LIST change confirmed scoped and clearly temporary
ISS-0623/GH-580 confirmed correctly filed and not bundled into this fix
